headline: Sangrur records high fire detections as Patiala air quality is forecast
briefing: On 2025-10-31, Sangrur district recorded 72 fire detections and a total FRP of 421.3 MW, placing it at rank 1 in Punjab. The 7-day mean was 26.7, representing a change vs 7d pct of 169.5. For the nearest monitored city of Patiala, the PM2.5 forecast for the next day gives a p50 of 90.8 ug/m3, with an 80% uncertainty band ranging from a p10 of 54.4 to a p90 of 103.2 ug/m3. Today's PM2.5 value was 91.9 ug/m3. Winds at Patiala blew from the NW at 8.1 km/h, with upwind fire pressure from contributors including Outside Punjab at 23.1 percent and Sangrur at 22.3 percent. Satellite fire detections represent a lower bound due to missed fires, cloud cover, and overpass timing limitations [K109].

# Sangrur: fire detections, season 2024

In the 2024 season (Sep 15 to Nov 30), satellite fire detection (VIIRS S-NPP) recorded 1,476 fire detections in Sangrur district, with a total fire radiative power of 7,906 MW. Among the 22 districts it ranked number 1 by detections.

The busiest day was 2024-11-08, with 199 detections.

Compared with the previous season: -70% compared with 2023 (5,002 detections).
